models.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

models.pooling: attention-masked mean of last hidden states, excluding padding and special tokens; L2 normalization
models.preprocessing: review and pin official normalize_text.py; record normalization and preserve original evidence text
models.interpretation: off-the-shelf domain-pretrained encoder with specified pooling; not a contrastively fine-tuned sentence encoder

experiments.change: same MiniLM; add full-claim evidence retrieval and BM25 to object-label retrieval; retain all channel ranks
same E1 pipeline, BGE encoder; recompute all indexed representations
same E1 pipeline, E5 encoder; recompute all indexed representations
cross-encoder rerank on identical frozen union candidate pool; end-to-end retrieval reported separately
independent upstream historical dual-Jaccard baseline with explicitly typed attribute mapping and coverage report
candidate compatibility review using whole predicate, object semantics, species, conditions, joint factors and assertion; report ablation separately
same E1 pipeline, MatSciBERT encoder with explicitly specified normalization and pooling; rebuild all indexed representations; no task fine-tuning in this first comparison

encoder_comparison.primary: fixed evidence content and 256-token cap, proper model-specific prefix/pooling; log actual truncation
encoder_comparison.secondary: native supported context length sensitivity analysis, explicitly not model-only comparison

regression_cases.issue: water loss vs desired water retention
retained through supplemental review, not original top5 success

evaluation.current_pilot: 4 needs and assistant reviews are development diagnostics, not independent gold
evaluation.initial_annotation_budget_suggestion: 200-400 query-claim items from pooled model outputs plus hard negatives; add more independently anchored needs before population claims
evaluation.blinding: domain annotators should not see model identity or score
evaluation.splits: group by paper/need; never split sibling claims randomly across train and test
metrics: pooled nDCG@10 with unjudged policy disclosed

temporal_followup.pretrained_future_exposure: document training cutoff; absent assurance call retrospective retrieval, not prospective prediction

acceptance: Adopt a new model only after same-task blinded held-out comparison shows a useful gain at an acceptable cost. Never replace the encoder solely on an external leaderboard or the upstream extraction F1.
user_update: Include MatSciBERT in the first encoder comparison; domain pretraining is a reason to test it, not evidence of a win or a reason to exclude it.
